    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CartLine
    Represents a line item in the shopping cart, including its price, quantity, and associated menu components.
    CashierController
    Class controller for cashier view fxml
    CashierRepository
    Handles cashier menu reads and checkout transactions.
    CashierRepository.CheckoutOutcome
     
    DatabaseApp
    Starts the JavaFX cashier application.
    DatabaseConnection
    Creates configured PostgreSQL connections for the application backend.
    DbSetup
     
    ManagerController
    Controller for the manager view and its inventory, sales, receipt, and report displays.
    ManagerData
    This class holds all the data for the manager controller, including sales, stock, receipts, and menu information.
    ManagerRepository
    Handles manager dashboard reads and updates in PostgreSQL.
    ManagerRepository.GraphPoint
     
    MealSize
    Represents meal sizes and their discounts
    MenuItem
    This class represents a menu item with its properties and provides getters and setters for each property.
    MenuListCell
    This class represents a custom ListCell for displaying MenuItem objects in a ListView.
    MenuRecord
    This class represents a menu record, including the item ID, name, and price.
    ReceiptRecord
    This class represents a receipt record, including the receipt ID, item name, quantity, line total, item ID, and timestamp.
    SalesRecord
    This class represents a sales record, including the name of the item and the quantity sold.
    StockGraphRecord
    This class represents a product/stock used record, including the name of the item and the quantity used.
    StockItem
    This class represents a stock item with its properties and provides getters and setters for each property.
    StockListCell
    This class represents a custom ListCell for displaying StockItem objects in a ListView.
    StockRecord
    This class represents a stock record, including the inventory ID, name, stock level, minimum stock level, next shipment date, and shelf life.
    StockUpdateResult
    This class represents the result of a stock update operation, including the new stock value, whether the update was successful, and whether the inventory record was missing.
    XRecord
    This class represents a sales record per hour (x report), including the hour and the quantity sold.
